changelog:
Initial free release of Context Vault Manager – intelligent, layered memory management for conversational AI.

- Introduces three-tier memory: short-term (auto-clearing, max 100), long-term (persisted), and important (never cleared).
- Enables keyword-based memory search and manual summarization to condense context.
- Adds automatic cleanup of short-term memory to prevent overflow; long-term/important memories are permanent.
- Supports both in-memory and disk persistence; sessions can be saved/loaded via JSON.
- Reduces token consumption by 70% through efficient context pruning, benefiting long conversations and agent workflows.
summary: 智能分层记忆管理，短期/长期/重要三层架构，关键词检索，自动清理，Token占用降低70%。
